title: Negative endpoint indicator
statement: For every integer $e$, define its sign bit to indicate whether $e<0$, and define its unsigned index to be $-e-1$ when $e<0$ and $e$ otherwise. The conjunction that $e$ is negative and its unsigned index is zero is true exactly when $e+1=0$.
